title: Go: Methods
description: Define methods on struct types using value receivers, pointer receivers, and implement the Stringer interface.

steps.title: Value Receiver
steps.description: Define a `Circle` struct with `Radius float64`. Add a method `Area()` that returns the area and print it.
hints: `func (c Circle) Area() float64 { return 3.14 * c.Radius * c.Radius }`

verification.failureMessage: Define a Circle with Area() method and print area for radius 5.

steps.title: Pointer Receiver
steps.description: Define a `Counter` struct with `Value int`. Add a pointer receiver method `Increment()` that increments `Value`, then print the result.
hints: Pointer receiver can modify the struct.
Create, call Increment twice, print Value.

verification.failureMessage: Increment counter twice and print the value 2.

steps.title: Method on Custom Type
steps.description: Define a custom type `MyInt int` with a method `IsEven() bool` that returns true if the value is even. Print the result.

verification.failureMessage: Define MyInt with IsEven() method and print true for 4.

steps.title: Method with Parameters
steps.description: Define a `Rectangle` struct with `W, H float64`. Add a method `Scale(factor float64)` that returns a new scaled rectangle. Print the new dimensions.
hints: `func (r Rectangle) Scale(f float64) Rectangle { return Rectangle{r.W * f, r.H * f} }`
Return a new value instead of modifying.
Create Rectangle{2,3}, Scale(2), print the new dimensions.

verification.failureMessage: Scale Rectangle{2,3} by 2 and print 4 and 6.

steps.title: Stringer Interface
steps.description: Define a `Point` struct with `X, Y int`. Implement the `Stringer` interface (`String() string`) and print a Point instance.
hints: `func (p Point) String() string { return fmt.Sprintf("(%d, %d)", p.X, p.Y) }`
When you print p, Go calls String() automatically.

verification.failureMessage: Implement String() on Point so fmt.Println shows (3,4).
